author: Good Enough
description:
High winds can become dangerous fast, turning loose objects into flying debris and making it difficult to walk, drive, or stay protected outdoors. Knowing where to shelter, how to avoid windows and trees, and what to do if you’re caught outside can greatly reduce your risk of injury.

This Short explains how to survive high winds, what to do during extreme wind events, how to protect yourself from flying debris, and the biggest mistakes to avoid during severe weather.
title: How to Survive High Winds 💨⚠️ #naturaldisaster #outdoors #survival #survivaltips
